open

Open a project and return its session id (visible editor window; --headless for a hidden render)

Usage:
  lceda-pro open --path <undefined> [--headless <boolean>]

Options:
  --path  Project file path (.eprj/.eprj2/.eprj3/.elib)
  --headless  Open without a visible window (hidden render); default opens a GUI window (default: false)

Global flags: see "lceda-pro --help"
